title: 46. Railroad Breakdown 3-Step SOS Procedure (Press -> Push -> Run)
summary: Railroad breakdown SOS steps: 1. Press Emergency Red Button. 2. Push vehicle off tracks. 3. Run away from tracks.
key_fact: 46. Railroad Breakdown 3-Step SOS Procedure (Press -> Push -> Run)
canonical_question: When a motor vehicle driver passes a railway level crossing and the vehicle suddenly stalls on the tracks and cannot be restarted, with the warning bell already ringing and the barrier beginning to lower, which of the following emergency responses is most correct according to accident prevention and emergency procedures?
canonical_options: (1) Immediately call the insurance company or a tow truck and wait for professionals to handle it.
(2) Since the train has not been seen yet, stay in the vehicle to protect it and keep trying to restart the engine until it starts.

(3) Immediately press the 'emergency button' beside the level crossing and try to push the vehicle off the tracks; if the train is approaching, quickly leave the vehicle and escape to open areas on both sides.
canonical_correct: (3) Immediately press the 'emergency button' beside the level crossing and try to push the vehicle off the tracks; if the train is approaching, quickly leave the vehicle and escape to open areas on both sides.

title: 47. Demerit Points Accumulation (12 Points in 1 Year = 2 Mo. Suspension)
summary: Accumulating 12 demerit points within 1 year results in a 2-month driver license suspension.
key_fact: 47. Demerit Points Accumulation (12 Points in 1 Year = 2 Mo. Suspension)
canonical_question: After completing drunk driving prevention education or alcohol addiction treatment and passing the required test, the obtained driver's license allows driving only vehicles equipped with an ignition interlock device (alcohol lock). What is the mandatory period of use?
canonical_options: (1) Half a year.
(2) 1 year.
(3) 3 years.
canonical_correct: (2) 1 year.

title: 48. Hit-and-Run Penalties with Injury or Death
summary: Fleeing the scene of an accident involving injury or death results in permanent driver license revocation and criminal charges.
key_fact: 48. Hit-and-Run Penalties with Injury or Death
canonical_question: Regarding drunk driving regulations, which of the following is correct?
canonical_options: (1) The standard for a breathalyzer test is a breath alcohol concentration of 0.25 mg per liter or a blood alcohol concentration of 0.10% or above.
(2) Re-offending drunk driving within 5 years is subject to a fine of NT$120,000.
(3) Refusing a sobriety test for drunk driving is subject to a fine of NT$180,000, and the vehicle shall be impounded on the spot and the driver's license revoked.
canonical_correct: (3) Refusing a sobriety test for drunk driving is subject to a fine of NT$180,000, and the vehicle shall be impounded on the spot and the driver's license revoked.

title: 49. Accident Scene Marking & Clearing Protocol
summary: In minor accidents without injuries, drivers MUST photograph/mark vehicle positions and move vehicles to the roadside immediately.
key_fact: 49. Accident Scene Marking & Clearing Protocol
canonical_question: If a motor vehicle driver causes an accident with no injuries or fatalities but fails to handle the situation as required and flees the scene, in addition to a fine of NT$1,000 to NT$3,000, what additional penalty shall be imposed?
canonical_options: (1) Revocation of the driver's license.
(2) Suspension of the driver's license for 1 to 3 months.
(3) Suspension of the vehicle license plates for 1 to 3 months.
canonical_correct: (2) Suspension of the driver's license for 1 to 3 months.

title: 50. Hazard Perception Defensive Driving Principles
summary: Defensive driving mandate: Constantly scan blind spots, monitor mirrors, slow at intersections, and anticipate hidden hazards.
key_fact: 50. Hazard Perception Defensive Driving Principles
canonical_question: Which of the following behaviors regarding 'changing lanes' is incorrect?
canonical_options: (1) When changing lanes, yield to vehicles traveling straight ahead and pay attention to safe following distance.
(2) Lane changes on both sides are permitted on double solid white lines.
(3) Activate the turn signal, turn your head to check the rearview mirror, check blind spots, and watch for obstacles, vehicles, or pedestrians.
canonical_correct: (2) Lane changes on both sides are permitted on double solid white lines.
